snapshot_note: This page shows the saved revision below. After a new save in Codex, reload this file. It does not check for later changes.
codex: Answer questions and request changes in Codex. This HTML does not save answers or execute commands.
no_js: JavaScript is disabled: all views are shown in the saved language. Interactive language switching is unavailable.
missing: Not available in this saved state
pending_view: The workspace shell is available. Detailed content for this view is not implemented yet; use Codex to inspect the saved information.
question_limit: Up to 10 questions; fewer may be enough. This is not a completion percentage.
answer_question: Answer the current question in Codex
proceed_with_assumptions: Review the saved assumptions in Codex
clarification_required: Clarify the next step in Codex
continue_codex: Review the saved next action in Codex
examples_note: Examples are suggestions, not saved answers. Reply in Codex.
no_goal: No Project Context Brief has been saved. Review the saved question or answer in Codex.
no_question: No question is pending in this saved state.
no_answers: No answers have been saved yet.
no_scan: No scan has been saved. Manual or idea-only context is still valid.
no_brief: No Project Context Brief has been saved yet.
scan_boundary: The scan does not execute project code, install dependencies or collect secrets. Requested targeted reads remain within the selected permissions and budget.
requested_not_read: A requested source is not evidence it was read.
correction_warning: Changing a saved answer or interpretation in Codex may invalidate dependent selection, request, retrieval and recommendation data. This is a prospective warning, not a recorded correction.
not_measured: A proposed criterion is not a measured outcome.
scan_fact_limit: A package finding does not prove running architecture.
translation_partial: Some narrative fields are shown in their original language.
no_memo: No recommendation memo has been saved. Continue the decision in Codex.
no_plan: No integration plan has been saved. Do not infer an implementation task.
draft_only: This comparison is a proposal, not a saved adoption decision or verified compatibility.
no_comparison_details: No structured comparison has been saved; missing cells remain unknown.
proposed: Proposed design; not observed running architecture.
handoff_instruction: Select and copy this scoped handoff into Codex; this page cannot execute it.
source_not_execution: Saved guidance only: no command, installation or project change has been executed.
blocked_candidate: Blocked by a hard constraint. A memo role does not make this candidate eligible.
reference_candidate: Reference only; required facts or checks remain unresolved.
unassigned_card: Present in the captured evidence pack without a saved recommendation role.
prior_publication: Previously observed HTML revision at save time
history_detail_unavailable: Run details are unavailable; only the saved ledger entry is shown.
history_request: Ask Codex to view the selected immutable run.
replay_note: Recorded pins describe reproducible candidate selection; future model wording is not guaranteed to match.
recovery_snapshot: This file knows only its generation revision. It cannot detect a later save, render failure, busy lock or storage error. Codex reports operation outcomes separately; a prior HTML revision is not this publication result.
recovery_request: Check the saved run and publication result in Codex. If retry=render_only is reported, retry rendering the unchanged saved revision once, then reload status.html. On state_conflict or render_superseded, inspect the current revision first. On state_busy, retry later without stealing the lock. On history_integrity or storage_limit, stop and review the recorded evidence; do not delete files or overwrite history automatically.
root_usage_unknown: Whole output-root usage is unavailable in this snapshot; ceilings are not measured usage.
privacy_note: Only minimized findings and saved answers are shown. Sanitized project content may still be confidential and enter Git or backups. No raw source/chat archive is embedded.
legacy_notice: Legacy read-only run: missing localization and structured details remain unknown. No migration or rewrite occurred.
history_immutable: Finalized runs are immutable. This is not an archive of every intermediate revision; corrections show only recorded events. Ask Codex to view a run or start a new run linked to its predecessor.
copy_manual: Clipboard unavailable: text selected. Use Ctrl+C or copy manually.
copy_hint: Select and copy this text manually when JavaScript or clipboard access is unavailable.
